app.name: AC Service Scheduler
lang.label: Language
update.ready: A new version of the app is ready.
backup.notice.one: You have not saved a backup for {count} day. Your data lives only in this browser.
backup.notice.other: You have not saved a backup for {count} days. Your data lives only in this browser.

route.title: Route
route.lede: The route of one technician for one day, from a file made by the planner. It works without a connection.
route.error.read: The file could not be read.
route.storage.none: This browser is not keeping files for the app, so the route stays only while this page is open.
route.storage.saveFailed: The route could not be saved on this phone. It stays only while this page is open.
route.empty.title: No route yet
route.empty.text: Your coordinator sends you a route file for the day. Open it here. After that it stays on this phone and opens without a connection.
route.made: {site}. Made {when}. If the plan has changed since, ask for a new file.
route.late: This route was for {date}, {ago}. Ask for a new file if you need a later day.
route.saved.title: Saved on this phone
route.removeReport: The report you entered for this route is removed with it.
route.stop.drive: {km} km, {min} min driving from the last stop
sheet.made: {site}. Made {when} for this day only. If the plan has changed since, ask for a new sheet.
map.none: There are no routes to show on a map.
map.legend.aria: Who is who on the map
map.hint: Tap a stop to see its details. Distances are drawn true to scale; there is no street map.
map.moved: Stops at the same place are drawn side by side. The small dot joined to a stop by a line is its true place.
map.day.heading: Map of {day}
share.title: Share and export
share.nobody: Nobody has a visit on this day.
share.packNote: A route pack is a small file the technician opens in this app on their phone, with no connection. It holds case numbers, places, times and distances, no customer details.
share.csv: CSV files, one table at a time
share.excel.failed: The Excel file could not be made. {detail}
held.unknown: The place or work type is not known
report.title: Report your visits
report.lede: Say how each visit went. What you enter is saved on this phone and works without a connection. When you have finished, send the report to your coordinator.
report.warning: Do not write customer names or phone numbers in the remarks.
report.reason.label: Why
report.time.label: Finished at
report.remarks.label: Remarks
report.none: Report at least one visit to send it.
report.sentAt: Made into a file {when}. Send it again after a change.
reports.title: Reports from technicians
reports.help: Technicians send a report file from the Route tab of their phone. You can open many at once.
reports.read: Read {files}. Visits: {added} new, {updated} changed, {unchanged} already known, {older} older than the ones kept.
reports.day: {day}: {reported} of {planned} reported. Done {done}, partly done {partly}, not done {notDone}.
reports.other.one: {count} report for this day is for a case that is not in its plan now, for example one you marked done.
reports.other.other: {count} reports for this day are for cases that are not in its plan now, for example ones you marked done.
reports.none: No reports for this day yet.
reports.problemMore: And {count} more. They are all in the Reports table of the Excel file.
reports.markHelp: A case reported done stays in the plan until you mark it, and then the next plan does not visit it again.
reports.marked: Marked {count} as done. The next plan will not visit them again.
report.err.notReport: This file is not a visit report.
report.err.version: This report was made by a different version of the app.
report.err.site: The name of the centre is missing.
report.err.date: The date of the route is missing, or it is not a date.
report.err.createdAt: The time the report was made is missing.
report.err.tooMany: The report has more than {max} visits.
report.err.tooBig: This file is too large to be a report.
report.err.visitStatus: the status is not Done, Partly done or Not done.
report.err.visitReason: the reason is not one of the known reasons.
report.err.visitTime: the time is not a time of day (HH:MM).
pack.err.notPack: This file is not a route pack.
pack.err.version: This route pack was made by a different version of the app.
pack.err.site: The name of the centre is missing.
pack.err.date: The date is not written as year-month-day.
pack.err.validFor: The valid-for date is not written as year-month-day.
pack.err.createdAt: The time the pack was made is not readable.
pack.err.noStops: This route pack has no stops.
pack.err.duplicate: Two stops have the same visit number.
pack.err.stopVisit: the visit number must be a whole number, 1 or more.
pack.err.stopLat: the latitude must be between -90 and 90.
pack.err.stopLon: the longitude must be between -180 and 180.
pack.err.stopArrival: the arrival time is not written like 09:30.
pack.err.stopKm: the distance must be a number of kilometres, 0 or more.
pack.err.stopMin: the driving time must be a number of minutes, 0 or more.
plan.title: Plan
plan.seeDemo: See the demo with invented data
plan.error: The plan could not be made. {error}
plan.lede: {cases} planned over {days}{left}. {used} of {total} technicians work. {drive} hours of driving, {onsite} hours on site. Starting {start}.
plan.large: This is a large set: {cases} cases, {technicians} technicians, {days} days. The app has been measured up to {testedCases} cases, {testedTechnicians} technicians and {testedDays} days, on a laptop. Planning more can take much longer, most of all on a phone. If the page slows down or stops, plan fewer cases at a time.
plan.baseFar: The base location of your centre is {km} km from the nearest case, so no visit fits in a day. Put the base in the middle of your cases, or set it yourself in Set-up.
plan.baseMiddle: Put the base in the middle of my cases
plan.switchHint: Switch a technician off to see the plan change.
plan.notPlanned.title: Not planned ({count})
plan.leftOut: Left out of the plan: {hold} on hold, {review} in review, {noPlace} without a known place.
plan.hint.skills: None of the active technicians has a skill matched, so nobody can take these cases. Give them skills in Set-up, or match the skill words when you import the technicians again.
plan.hint.generic: Nothing could be planned. The reasons are listed below.
plan.blocked.noTech.title: Import your technicians
plan.blocked.noTech.text: The plan needs to know who can do the visits. Import a file of technicians, or add them in Set-up.
plan.blocked.noCases.title: Import your cases
plan.blocked.noCases.text: Import a file of service cases and they will be planned here.
plan.blocked.nothing.title: Nothing is ready to plan
plan.blocked.nothing.text: {hold} on hold, {review} in review, {ignored} ignored, {done} done, {closed} closed. Only cases that are ready to plan are planned.
plan.blocked.allOff.title: Switch a technician on
plan.blocked.allOff.text: Every technician is switched off, so nobody can take a visit.
plan.blocked.unplannable.title: No case can be planned yet
plan.blocked.unplannable.text: The ready cases have no place or work type that the planner knows. Fix the problems listed in the Data tab.
demo.note: Demo with invented data. Nothing here is real.
demo.lede: {cases} scheduled over {days}{left}. {used} of {total} technicians work. {drive} hours of driving, {onsite} hours on site.
board.meta.one: {count} stop, {onsite} h on site, {drive} h driving
board.meta.other: {count} stops, {onsite} h on site, {drive} h driving

data.decisions.note: These stay when the file is imported again.
data.empty.title: Nothing imported yet
data.empty.text: Import a file of service cases, technicians or places and they will be listed here.
data.noMatch: No case matches. Try fewer words or another filter.
data.problems.title: Problems to fix ({n})
data.technicians.title: Technicians ({n})
data.imports.title: Imports so far
data.detail.categoryUnmatched: The category “{name}” is not matched to a work type.
data.detail.placeUnknown: The place ({given}) is not in your place table.

import.title: Import
import.lede: Bring in service cases, technicians or places from a file. You match its columns once and the app remembers.
import.file.heading: Choose a file
import.file.help: A CSV, Excel (.xlsx) or JSON export from your system. The file stays in this browser.
import.file.choose: Choose a file or drop it here
import.file.known: You have imported a file with these columns before. The saved matching will be used.
import.file.encodingGuess: The text encoding was guessed. If letters look wrong below, choose another one under "Not reading right?".
import.file.headerRow: The column names are on row
import.columns.heading: Match the columns
import.columns.help: Say which column of your file holds what. Matches the app is sure about are filled in; please check them.
import.dates.legend: Your dates could be read two ways. Which is right?
import.dates.legendSample: Your dates could be read two ways: {sample}. Which is right?
import.noType: There is no category column. All cases in this file are:
import.placeHint: At least one place column is needed: area, postal code, address, or latitude with longitude.
import.personal: May contain personal data. Leave empty unless you need it.
import.values.heading: Match the words
import.values.help: Your file uses its own words. Match each one once; the app remembers them for the next file.
import.values.workType.title: Work types
import.values.workType.help: Match each category in your file to one of your work types.
import.values.status.title: Status
import.values.status.help: Say what to do with cases in each status. A status you do not match is planned.
import.values.priority.title: Priority
import.values.priority.help: Match each priority word to a priority level. One you do not match counts as the lowest level.
import.values.skill.title: Skills
import.values.skill.help: Match each skill word to one of your skills. One you do not match is left out.
import.values.leaveInReview: Leave unmatched categories in review for now
import.need.bothCoords: Choose both a latitude and a longitude column, or neither.
import.need.place: Choose at least one place column: area, postal code, address, or latitude with longitude.
import.need.categories.one: {count} category is not matched to a work type yet.
import.need.categories.other: {count} categories are not matched to a work type yet.
import.check.heading: Check and import
import.check.badDates.one: {count} {field} value is not a date, for example {examples}.
import.check.badDates.other: {count} {field} values are not a date, for example {examples}.
import.check.places.one: {count} place was not found. Those cases are imported and wait in the problem list until the place is added.
import.check.places.other: {count} places were not found. Those cases are imported and wait in the problem list until the place is added.
import.check.nothing: Nothing can be imported with this matching. Go back and check the columns.
import.summary.removed: {count} no longer in the file and now closed.
import.summary.problems.one: {count} problem to look at in the Data tab.
import.summary.problems.other: {count} problems to look at in the Data tab.

setup.title: Set-up
setup.lede: Tell the planner about your centre. Changes are saved as you make them and the plan follows.
setup.site.title: Your centre
setup.site.name: Name of the centre
setup.site.baseHelp: Where the technicians start and end the day, unless a technician has a place of their own.
setup.site.noGeo: This browser cannot tell where you are.
setup.site.denied: Your location was not shared. Type the latitude and longitude instead.
setup.rules.title: Working rules
setup.rules.help: The starting values suit most centres. Change them to match yours.
setup.rules.speedHelp: Used to turn distance into driving time.
setup.rules.roadHelp: Road distance divided by straight-line distance, usually 1.2 to 1.5.
setup.rules.hop: Time between visits in one area (minutes)
setup.rules.maxKmHelp: Not used by the planner yet. A day's driving time limits trips.
setup.rules.hoursHelp: Driving and visits, not counting the break.
setup.rules.horizon: Plan this many working days ahead
setup.rules.ageWeightHelp: Points per day a case has waited. Higher plans old cases sooner.
setup.rules.balanceWeightHelp: Higher spreads visits more evenly between technicians.
setup.rules.dueWeightHelp: Points per day once a due date is near.
setup.rules.urgency: Days before a due date when urgency grows
setup.types.title: Work types
setup.types.help: Each kind of visit, how long it takes, how many a technician can do in a day, and the skill it needs.
setup.skills.title: Skills
setup.skills.help: What technicians are approved to do. A work type needs one skill.
setup.levels.title: Priority levels
setup.levels.help: Lowest first. A higher weight plans a case sooner. The weight is added to how long the case has waited.
setup.places.title: Places ({n})
setup.places.help: Every visit needs a place with coordinates. You can also import a file of places in the Import tab.
setup.places.none: No places yet. Import cases with coordinates, import a file of places, or add one below.
setup.places.showing: Showing 50 of {n}. Use the search to find the rest.
setup.alias.title: Other spellings of a place
setup.alias.help: Files spell places in different ways. Say which place a spelling means and it is matched during imports.
setup.techs.title: Technicians ({n})
setup.techs.help: Who does the visits. Leave a field empty to use the centre's own value. You can also import a file of technicians.
setup.techs.none: No technicians yet. Import a file or add one below.
setup.holidays.title: Holidays ({n})
setup.holidays.help: Days nobody works, besides the weekly days off. The planner skips them.
setup.data.title: Your data and files
setup.data.where: Everything is kept in this browser only. Nothing is sent anywhere. Now holding: {size}.
setup.data.privacy: What is kept: your cases, technicians, places, set-up, the route files you open and the visit reports technicians write and coordinators open. Where: only in this browser, on this device. How long: until you delete it (below), until the time you chose for finished work runs out (below, off unless you choose one), or until the browser clears it. Who can see it: whoever can open this browser on this device. A file you send, such as a route pack, a report file or an Excel file, leaves the app, and whoever receives it can read it.
setup.data.site.title: The set-up of your centre
setup.data.site.help: Work types, skills, priority levels, places and rules, without any cases. Use it to set up another browser or share it.
setup.data.backup.title: A backup of everything
setup.data.backup.help: The set-up plus all cases, technicians and saved column matchings. It contains your case data, so keep it private.
setup.data.restore.text: Restoring {file} replaces everything now in the app with {cases}, {technicians} and {places}.
setup.data.retention.title: Keep finished work for
setup.data.retention.help: Finished cases (done, or no longer in your system's export) and the reports from technicians can be removed from this browser after a time you choose. Nothing is removed by itself until you choose one.
setup.data.retention.statusOff: Off: nothing is removed by itself.
setup.data.retention.statusOn: On: a finished case is removed {days} days after the day it was finished, and a report {days} days after the day of its route.
setup.data.retention.aria: Keep finished work for a time
setup.data.retention.finished: Finished cases now: {count}. Each is removed {days} days after the day it was finished, counting from today for the ones that are finished already.
setup.data.retention.catch: A case that your system still lists as open comes back as a new case at the next import. Save a backup first if you may need what is removed.
setup.data.msg.retentionOn: Finished work is now kept for {days} days.
setup.data.msg.retentionOff: Finished work is kept until you delete it.
retention.notice: Removed {what}, as you chose to keep finished work for {days} days.
setup.data.install.title: Install on this device
setup.data.install.help: Installed, the app opens full screen from the home screen and works without a connection.
setup.data.install.noButton: If there is no install button
setup.data.install.chrome: Chrome on Android: open the menu (three dots), then choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
setup.data.install.samsung: Samsung Internet: open the menu, choose Add page to, then Home screen.
setup.data.install.firefox: Firefox on Android: open the menu, then choose Install.
setup.data.install.safari: Safari on iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
setup.data.storage.title: Storage
setup.data.storage.memory: This browser is not keeping your data. It will be lost when you close the page. Save a backup before you leave.
setup.data.storage.kept: The browser has promised to keep your data.
setup.data.storage.mayClear: The browser may clear your data when it runs short of space. Save a backup now and then.
setup.data.storage.checking: Checking whether the browser will keep your data…
setup.data.delete.title: Delete all my data
setup.data.delete.help: Removes the cases, technicians, places, saved matchings, set-up, opened route files and visit reports from this browser. This cannot be undone. Save a backup first if you may need it.
setup.data.msg.savedSite: Saved the set-up as a file.
